# clio auth token list

Show labels, actors, banks, and created_at; never a secret or a digest

## Usage

```
clio auth token list [--output json|text]
```

## Description

prints labels, actors, banks, and creation times; never a secret and never a digest; --db, --backend, --actor, and --bank are refused because they cannot change the listing

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

List labels, actors, banks, and creation times.
```
clio auth token list
```

Emit the listing as JSON.
```
clio auth token list -o json
```
